title: Assessing the Human-Likeness of LLM-Driven Digital Twins in Simulating Health Care System Trust

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated survey responses to human reference data using item-level distributions, standard deviations, and chi-square tests to identify variance collapse, centralization of responses, and extreme aversion.

Conducting subgroup analyses across age, gender, and educational levels to assess the LLM's ability to accurately model and simulate demographic heterogeneity and subtle attitude differences found in real human populations.
